ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Laxmi Dental Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Updates — Laxmi Dental Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board Comments On The Fine Levied By The NSE And BSE'.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Laxmi Dental Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results (Consolidated and Standalone) for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations —  Dharmesh Dattani has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Laxmi Dental Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the audited financial results (standalone and consolidated) for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations — Laxmi Dental Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.

Appointment — Laxmi Dental Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  M/s. Bathiya Advisors LLP, Chartered Accountants, as Internal Auditors of the company w.e.f. April 01, 2026 for the FY 2026-27.

Appointment — Laxmi Dental Limited has informed the Exchange regarding appointment of M/s. Abhay Subhash & Associates, Chartered Accountants, as Tax Auditors of the Company w.e.f. April 01, 2025 for the FY 2025-26.
Amalgamation/Merger — Laxmi Dental Limited has informed the Exchange about Amalgamation/Merger
Outcome of Board Meeting — Laxmi Dental Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Un-audited Financial Results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025.

Updates — Laxmi Dental Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Board comments on fine levied by the Exchange for non-compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and DisclosureRequirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ).
Outcome of Board Meeting — Laxmi Dental Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2025.

aud.t: Appointment — Laxmi Dental Limited has informed the Exchange regarding appointment of M/s. Abhay Subhash & Associates, Chartered Accountants, as Tax Auditors of the Company w.e.f. April 01, 2025 for the FY 2025-26.
